reviews.title: Good game, bad app
reviews.text:
My 2.5 year old really enjoys the game. I like that he is learning and continually unlocking new games that continue to challenge him. 

The problem is the app is incredibly buggy. On my iPad Pro the app sometimes opens immediately, and sometimes hangs for nearly five minutes. That’s a long time for a child to wait to play a game. When it hangs on the iPad, I let him play on my iPhone. But on my phone there’s usually no audio.
The volume is up and I have sound with other apps. I’ve deleted and reinstalled the app, but the issue persists. I let him play the game with no sound on my phone until it eventually loads on my iPad.

I want to continue using and enjoying this game for my son, but the ongoing bugs in the app take away from an otherwise positive experience.

reviews.text: I had a bad experience with this app. It’s supposed to be a speech therapy tool but out of the blue the apps sound stopped working. I checked all settings and even shut down and restarted my phone. I then had to delete the app and reinstall for the app to work and when that did resolve the sound issue it then wiped all the history I made with the worksheets progress. Maybe in a year once significant bugs are fixed I can recommend this app, but until then I say check out the Speech Blubs app for a kid-friendly speech therapy tool.

reviews.title: Do not download this app!
reviews.text:
Keiki advertises that you can “cancel anytime,” but that was absolutely not my experience. I downloaded it thinking it would be educational for my 2.5-year-old, but after using it, we realized he is still too young to properly grasp technology in a healthy way. Instead of learning, he became extremely upset and irritated whenever we tried to take the game away. We started noticing signs of dependency and decided we wanted him learning and playing without screens instead. 

When I tried to cancel, I found out they still expect me to keep paying around $40 a month for something we do not even use. In this economy, that is ridiculous. On top of that, their subscription pricing makes absolutely no sense — there are multiple different prices everywhere, and it feels intentionally confusing and misleading.

This app feels like a total money grab. Parents should be very careful before signing up because “cancel anytime” does not mean what you think it means. Complete rip off.

reviews.title: Scam you out of money
reviews.text: This app leads people to believe there’s a one time charge of $10 and then charges multiple times a month. Many people in the reviews have also complained of the same thing. It’s a great app, but they do not make users aware of the actual costs that will be charged to them. Some people said it was taking $40/monthly out of their account, some people were saying it was charging multiple times a month. Costs are inconsistent. I only got use of this app for a month before they tried to charge me again even though it was stated the $10 was a one time charge.

reviews.title: Overcharging Scam-DO NOT BUY
reviews.text:
I purchased the app with the intent of allowing my child to use it. I realize it didn’t align with my goal of less screen time and I decided to not use it. I ate the cost of the initial subscription. I just saw my bank statement and it double charged me $70. I am now in dispute with the company to get my money back.

Do not buy this app. They will charge you randomly and they will overcharge you from the agreed amount that you initially subscribed to. The games themselves are. They require your child to have ample amount of screen time and tablet use. So if you’re trying to teach them, but not increase their screen time this is not the game for you. This is not the app for you. This is just another child’s video game.

If I could give them a zero simply because of the dishonest business practice I would. Do not buy this do not support them.

reviews.title: Sound quality
reviews.text: This app would get a 4-5 stars if the sound wasn’t messed up. The intro to the app is loud and the kids who have them pronounce words are loud but the character inside each game is LOW and even with my phone on full blast, we can’t hear her. That’s kind detrimental to the learning because she’s giving directions and we CANT HEAR HER. I think this is a new issue too because we’ve used this app before and I don’t believe we had this issue. Please fix? I even went to other apps in my phone to find out if maybe something was wrong on my end and internal sounds on other apps are fine.

reviews.title: Free trial fail
reviews.text:
I’m extremely disappointed with Keiki Learning Games for Kids and how they handle their subscriptions.

First off, they advertise a free trial and claim they will notify you before it ends—but that never happened in my case. I received no reminder at all, and my account was automatically charged without any warning. That already feels misleading.

To make things worse, the purchase was actually made by my child, which is something many parents worry about with apps like this. I reached out to request a refund as soon as I noticed the charge, explaining the situation clearly. Despite that, they refused to issue a refund.

I only kept the app during the free trial because I trusted that I’d be notified before being charged, as they stated. That didn’t happen, and now I’m stuck paying for something I didn’t intend to continue.

Overall, this feels like a lack of transparency and poor customer service. Parents should be very cautious with this app, especially when it comes to subscriptions and in-app purchases.

reviews.title: Bad Costumer Service
reviews.text: I purchased the membership because of a misleading ad that I saw that led me to believe that this would include physical worksheets and supplies sent to me by mail not just an online app. When I reached out to Customer Service for a full refund, we went back-and-forth multiple times (with them stating that refunds were not part of their policy) and I had to threaten to report them to the FTC before I could get a refund. I was even willing to be a customer once my babies got older and introduced to screens and even then they didn’t give me a refund and now they just lost a customer for life because of how hard it was to deal with them and get a simple refund.

reviews.title: DO NOT DOWNLOAD
reviews.text:
Absolutely Disgraceful Billing Practices – Avoid

The games themselves are enjoyable and my toddler genuinely liked them. However, that is where the positive experience ends.

Within just one month of use, I was charged over £140. There was no clear explanation of what these charges were for, and I certainly did not knowingly agree to such large payments. As a parent, I am more than willing to pay a fair subscription fee for quality content but not unexplained, excessive charges taken in large amounts.

I have emailed the company multiple times requesting clarification and received no response whatsoever. The lack of customer service is deeply concerning. When money is being taken from families’ bank accounts, transparency and communication are the bare minimum.

This experience has been incredibly upsetting and stressful. Parents should be extremely cautious before downloading this app. Until the billing practices and customer support improve, I cannot recommend it to anyone.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I’m disappointed at how I got to my subscription. I’ve been seeing ads about this app a lot, and it seemed interesting enough to use for my child. To have other charges being made without me giving authorization for each charge is disheartening and I feel deceived. I’ve already paid for the initial subscription of the app and will see how the app goes for my daughter. As for the additional charger, I hope I get a refund as I will not be using those services and did not want to get them to begin with. I thought by clicking on the additional option it would give me a notice that I would be charged before actually charging me. Feeling tricked into spending twice as much money as I initially had planned for this app. I would like others to be aware of how this app goes about giving you their services.

reviews.title: Hidden Subscription
reviews.text: There is absolutely hidden subscriptions in this app. It is not made clear at all you are subscribing. It looks like a free trial or one off £40 payment but then they some how re-bill you monthly through Apple Pay without it coming up as a subscription. Absolutely disgusting to be cheating money out of hard working parents. I’m sure it’ll be hidden somewhere in the terms but it’s really just a SCAM at the expense of toddlers. Gross.

reviews.title: Foul play
reviews.text: Please tell me why I’m being charged for a subscription when I didn’t approve to buy or register as a monthly subscriber. I was instructed to fill in details to tailor my son’s speak needs and then it instructed me to pay £10 for the tailored plan only for me to receive an email that another £14 had been debited from my account simultaneously without my consent for an auto renewal plan which I never agreed to? It’s just dodgy to be honest.
